the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The forward implication is immediate. Conversely, every point s of the locally Noetherian base is a specialization of a generic point eta of an irreducible component; the cited Properties lemma supplies a morphism from the spectrum of a DVR carrying eta to the generic point and 0 to s; both cycles then have fibres at s mapping to the same element of the closed-fibre cycle group, namely the specialization of the common generic fibre; and the base change map is injective by the relative-fields section, whence the fibres agree everywhere (source lines 1097-1112)
